scripts.verify: npm run lint && npx tsc --noEmit && npm test && npm run build:worker && npm run verify:worker-build && npm run verify:compose && npm run verify:docker-layout
scripts.docker:build: npm run verify:docker-env && npm run verify:compose && npm run verify:docker-layout && docker compose build
scripts.docker:up: npm run verify:docker-env && npm run verify:compose && npm run verify:docker-layout && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.docker:down: docker compose stop web worker && docker compose stop redis postgres && docker compose down
scripts.docker:local:up: npm run verify:docker-env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db up --build -d --wait
scripts.docker:local:demo: npm run verify:docker-env && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db up --build -d --wait && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db --profile demo up -d seed
scripts.test:cache-worker:docker: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db --profile verify run --rm verify-cache-worker
scripts.docker:local:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db stop web worker && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db stop redis postgres && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.local-db.yml --profile local-db down
